risk_summary: The disclosure is materially risk-negative, citing deteriorating project visibility, cancellations or delays, oil-price and COVID-19 uncertainty, and potential reductions in backlog and bids. Additional concerns include $134.0 million of long-term debt, debt extinguishment losses, investigations, and executive misappropriation. Although operating results improved in 2019 and the discussion is substantially quantified, forward-looking outcomes remain highly uncertain.
